fullPassage: Unfortunately, sometimes the idea of a goal is disconnected from the daily reality of what it will take to achieve it. We fall in love with the idea of a goal, pushing out of mind how different our day-to-day will need to be for us to make it happen. In fact, research even suggests that positive fantasies about our future can lead us to put less effort into our goals because our fantasies provide us with a false and premature sense of accomplishment. We romanticize a goal — falling in love with the idea of a change. In the process, we gloss over the intricacies and challenges of integrating a complex new behavior into our life. As one study nicely summed it up, fantasizing about a positive future “seduces a person to mentally enjoy the desired future in the here and now” — and because we don't reflect on why our fantasy is not yet our future, “a necessity to act is not induced.”

❌ ① (A) 거스름돈 — (B) 변화: (A)는 삶이 바뀌는 '변화', (B)는 돈을 내고 받은 '거스름돈'으로 뒤바뀜
❌ ② (A) 변화 — (B) 변화: (B)는 계산 후 받은 '거스름돈'이지 '변화'가 아님
✅ ③ (A) 변화 — (B) 거스름돈: (A) 목표가 가져올 '변화', (B) 돈을 내고 받은 '거스름돈' ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 거스름돈 — (B) 거스름돈: (A)는 '변화'로, 거스름돈이 아님
det.tip: change: 변화(a change) vs 거스름돈/잔돈(my change). 문맥으로 구별

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a thing that someone has succeeded in doing, usually after a lot of effort"

det.korean: "많은 노력 끝에 성공적으로 해낸 것" = accomplishment(성취, 업적)
det.analysis:
❌ ① fantasy(환상) — 노력으로 이룬 것이 아니라 상상
❌ ② behavior(행동) — 성취가 아닌 행동 방식
❌ ③ necessity(필요성) — 반드시 필요한 것, 정의와 무관
✅ ④ accomplishment(성취) — 노력 끝에 성공적으로 해낸 것 ←정답
det.tip: accomplishment = 성취, 업적. a sense of accomplishment = 성취감

questions.passage: In the process, we gloss over the intricacies and challenges of __________ (integrate) a complex new behavior into our life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사: integrate → integrating
det.analysis: 전치사 of의 목적어 자리에 동사가 오면 동명사(-ing) 형태가 되어야 함. integrate(통합하다) → integrating. '복잡한 새 행동을 삶에 통합하는 것'의 의미
det.tip: the challenges of + 동명사: ~하는 것의 어려움. 전치사 뒤 동사는 동명사

questions.passage: Our fantasies provide us with a false and premature sense of __________ (accomplish). We fall in love with the idea of a goal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 전치사 of 뒤 명사 자리: 동사 accomplish → 명사 accomplishment(성취)
det.analysis: 'a sense of ___' 구조에서 of 뒤 명사가 필요. 동사 accomplish(성취하다)를 명사형 accomplishment(성취)로 변형. a sense of accomplishment = 성취감
det.tip: a sense of accomplishment = 성취감. 동사 accomplish → 명사 accomplishment

questions.passage: Unfortunately, sometimes the idea of a goal is disconnected from the daily reality of what it will take to achieve it. We __________ with the idea of a goal, pushing out of mind how different our day-to-day will need to be for us to make it happen. In fact, research even suggests that positive fantasies about our future can lead us to put less effort into our goals because our fantasies provide us with a false and premature sense of accomplishment. We romanticize a goal — falling in love with the idea of a change. In the process, we gloss over the intricacies and challenges of integrating a complex new behavior into our life. As one study nicely summed it up, fantasizing about a positive future “seduces a person to mentally enjoy the desired future in the here and now” — and because we don't reflect on why our fantasy is not yet our future, “a necessity to act is not induced.”
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 목표라는 생각과 '사랑에 빠진다(fall in love)' — 그것을 이상적으로 여김
det.analysis:
✅ ① fall in love(사랑에 빠지다) — We ___ with the idea of a goal ←정답, 목표라는 생각에 매료됨
❌ ② give up(포기하다) — 매료되는 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ run away(도망치다) — 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ hold back(억제하다) — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: fall in love with the idea = ~라는 생각에 푹 빠지다, 매료되다

det.korean: 복잡한 행동을 통합할 때의 복잡함과 어려움을 '얼버무리고 넘어간다(gloss over)'
det.analysis:
❌ ① make up(지어내다) — 어려움을 다루는 문맥과 무관
✅ ② gloss over(얼버무리다) — we ___ the intricacies and challenges ←정답, 어려움을 대충 넘김
❌ ③ carry out(수행하다) — 어려움을 실행하는 것이 아님
❌ ④ come across(우연히 마주치다) — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: gloss over = (문제·어려움을) 얼버무리다, 대충 넘기다
